summary: No new receipt this turn, but a completeness check of my own record found a real gap and I fixed it: a scan for hex receipt ids in the parent interpretation's text showed four child receipts cited as evidence (the resurrect pair 226f9762f0b444f69c154b35fe0788f3 and 7adf927d528b4a74942c03b155aa8557, and the forgotten-voter pair b1daa1f4c9444b8d857bc7e0ab761691 and ec2c61af79bd42d7a5fe00657b7aeb22) were missing from that interpretation's executions map, so the controller could not associate them with the parent account even though the conclusions in its limitations rested on them. All four are now recorded with their decisive parsed indices, bringing the parent's map to twenty-one receipts; the only cited id that stays outside the map is the build-failure receipt, and the process note now says explicitly that it is deliberately excluded because a failed build yields no parsed observations. Nothing in the account's claims changed — this was purely an association and traceability repair.
